from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        planner = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.llm,
            num_rounds=1,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_PLAN_PROMPT],
        )
        plan = await planner(problem)
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_PLAN_WORKER_PROMPT_A.replace("{plan}", plan["response"]),
                prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_PLAN_WORKER_PROMPT_B.replace("{plan}", plan["response"]),
                prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_PLAN_WORKER_PROMPT_C.replace("{plan}", plan["response"]),
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_PLAN_STAR_AGG_PROMPT.replace("{plan}", plan["response"]),
        )
        solution = await star(problem)
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

{problem}
